item.title: Healed Knee Scar Mobilization
clinicalUse: Healed postoperative scar limiting skin glide or knee movement
contact: Fingertips adjacent to and then over fully healed scar.
forceDirection: Gentle longitudinal, transverse, circular and lifting glides.
dosage: 1–3 minutes, 1–2 times/day for self-care if skin tolerates and clinician has taught technique.
safety: Stop for redness, drainage, wound opening.
item.visualCue: Healed scar → small multidirectional skin glides → add knee motion.

subTechniques.name: Quadriceps — Scar Mobilization
subTechniques.clinicalGoal: Improve pain, movement tolerance or tissue-related function when this target is clinically relevant.
subTechniques.patientSetup: Supine, prone or sitting with the knee comfortably supported.
subTechniques.contact: Fingertip or broad contact on a fully healed scar in the Quadriceps region.
subTechniques.direction: Move a fully healed scar longitudinally, transversely and in small circles; progress gradually with healing stage.
subTechniques.dosage: Short bouts of about 1–3 minutes per area.
subTechniques.reassess: Re-test the region's original pain, range or functional task.
